resolutions.start_name: Majnoon oil field liquid trap / gas-gathering facility, Basrah governorate, Iraq

resolutions.corridor_desc: The physical pipe is short (SCOP: 7,500 m; sheet 8 km), 24 in, so it CANNOT span Majnoon field to the North Rumaila NGL plant (~75-90 km SW). The sourced corridor is therefore local: it runs from the Majnoon field liquid trap/gas facility (NE of Basra, ~31.30N 47.36E, near the Maysan border) a few km to a tie-in with the existing Majnoon->North Rumaila gas transmission line. 'North Rumaila' in the sheet is the gas's downstream PROCESSING destination (Ar Ratawi NGL plant, ~75 km W of Basra), not this pipe's physical terminus. Start point is well-anchored to a named field; the ~8 km physical end (a tie-in point) could not be geolocated, so its coordinates are left null. Corridor bounded to the Majnoon field area within Basrah governorate.
resolutions.researcher_notes: NO GEOMETRY STAGED: unresolved end; coordinates are not fabricated. Start coordinates anchored to the Majnoon oil field (latitude.to / Wikipedia: ~31.30N, 47.36E; ~60 km from Basra near the Maysan/Iran border) — the liquid trap is a facility within that field, so this is a defensible field-level point, not an invented one. End coordinates deliberately left null: the ~8 km physical terminus is an unnamed tie-in point I could not geolocate, and the North Rumaila / Ar Ratawi NGL plant (the stated downstream destination) is ~75 km away and cannot be this short pipe's endpoint. resolutions.corridor_desc: The line runs roughly 40 km from the Summail gas field to the Duhok Gas Power Station, both within Duhok (Dohuk) governorate, Kurdistan Region of Iraq. The producing field lies in the Dohuk PSC block described as the southwest neighbourhood of Duhok (~80 km north of Mosul); the destination Mass Global power station sits at Gawasha on the Duhok-Zakho road northwest of Duhok city. Sources give only the ~40 km field-to-station distance, so the corridor is a loose ~40 km bound trending generally north/northwest from the field to the Gawasha plant. Precise field coordinates were NOT independently sourced (left null, not fabricated); the plant coordinate is an approximate placement of the Gawasha/Duhok-Zakho-road power station (~36.95N, 42.78E) and should be treated as approximate, not a surveyed endpoint.

resolutions.start_name: Dry-gas supply tap on the Basra dry-gas distribution network (unnamed node, ~4.5 km from the plant; part of the South Gas Company / Khor Al-Zubair-fed trunk serving Basra power stations)
resolutions.end_name: Al Najibiya power station, Al-Najibiya district, Basra city (west bank of the Shatt al-Arab)
resolutions.corridor_desc: Short (~4.5 km) 12-inch dry-gas lateral inside Basra city, terminating at the Al Najibiya power station in the Al-Najibiya neighborhood on the west bank of the Shatt al-Arab, just south of central Basra. The upstream end is a tap on the dry-gas network that OPC/South Gas Company is extending to Basra power stations (fed from the Khor Al-Zubair gas complex ~30 km south, via the separate 40 km/42-in Khor Al-Zubair→Shatt al-Arab trunk, P7435). The exact source node and the pipe's routing are NOT published; only the plant end is locatable. The end coordinate is a district-centroid approximation for the named Al-Najibiya neighborhood, NOT a surveyed pipeline terminus — treat as loose. Given 4.5 km, the entire corridor lies within ~5 km of 30.49N/47.81E inside urban/peri-urban Basra.
resolutions.researcher_notes: NO GEOMETRY STAGED: unresolved start; coordinates are not fabricated. End endpoint (Al Najibiya PS) established from the power-technology plant profile (Basra, ~500 MW gas/dual-fuel, GE 9E) plus INA/ninanews maintenance coverage — the facility is unambiguous and lies in the named Al-Najibiya district of Basra. End lat/lon (30.49, 47.81) is a defensible district-level approximation of that named neighborhood, NOT a fabricated precise terminus; flagged approximate. Start node coordinates left NULL — the specific dry-gas tap feeding this 4.5 km lateral is not published anywhere I could source; I decline to invent a point. Corridor/supply context (Khor Al-Zubair-fed dry-gas program to Basra power stations) from powernews.cc p=238204, which documents the parallel 40 km/42-in trunk (P7435) but does NOT name the Najibiya feeder. NO coordinates were fabricated.
